title: Telemetry Dashboard GUI
description: Implement `web/cards/wdd_telemetry.html` and `web/cards/brand.css`. This React card reads `mailbox/events/` (mocked) and displays the realtime burn rate and workorder statuses.

requirements.styling: Must strictly use the dark-mode `brand.css` A:iB styling.
requirements.react: Build using standalone React and Babel.

acceptance_criteria: The HTML card loads visually in a browser.
failure_modes: FAIL: Using external UI libraries instead of pure HTML/CSS React.
